title: Under-the-radar bottlenecks
thesis: Find overlooked private startups with disclosed financing valuations around $100M or below across specialist AI, industrial technology, logistics, healthcare and climate. Explain the current external change creating demand, the specific company fit and the weakest link. Compare price evidence and downside. Larger comparisons may appear separately; never substitute funding amounts, SAFE caps or target prices for closed round valuations.

tailwind.customerNeed: New chips need inference software stacks to run models.
tailwind.companyFit: Infinity says its Ignition agent generates stacks and kernels for non-Nvidia chips.
tailwind.weakestLink: Large chip owners may build software in-house rather than buy it.
